fullText.simplified:
十三、游医的药

    六月，西湖风景最美的时候，白素贞和许仙结婚了。他们一起住在了西湖边。九月，许仙结束了他在药店的工作。十月，他和白素贞在西湖边开了一家药店，白素贞卖药，许仙给人看病。没有病人的时候，他们就去山里采药，生活过得平静而美好。小青和他们住在一起，看到他们过得幸福，她也很开心。
    很快，一年过去了。第二年春天，看病的人一下子多了起来，很多人都生病了。虽然他们看了医生，也吃了药，但病一直不能好。许仙这儿也来了不少病人，但他也看不出他们得的是什么病。
    后来街上来了一个游医，他说他知道大家得的是什么病。病人们都去找他，他只简单地看了一下，就拿出一个瓶子，从瓶子里倒出一杯水，说：“一百块钱！喝了这个药水，病就好了！”一百块太贵了，很多人没有钱，游医就把药拿回去了，说：“有钱了再来！”有人想办法到处借钱，终于借到了一百块，买到了药水。喝完药水，病真的就好了。
    大家听了，马上都去借钱。很快，全城的人都在借钱，而游医也越来越有钱了。
    许仙想办法拿到了一点儿游医的药水，但他看了半天也不知道那是什么药水。白素贞看了一眼，心里有些吃惊。她来到街上，远远地看到那个游医，然后她就明白了。
    晚上，白素贞和小青用了一个法术，来到了游医睡觉的房间。
    游医正在床上睡觉，白素贞再用了一个法术，游医变成了一只黑羊。
    “姐姐，你说得没错，他真的是妖！还是只黑羊妖！”小青说。
    白素贞在黑羊身下找到了那个药瓶。
    “姐姐，这个瓶子真的是神仙的东西吗？”
    “是的，这瓶子是南极仙翁的东西。里面的水叫净水，生病的人喝了马上就能好。”
    “这么好的东西，怎么到了黑羊妖手里？”
    “我不知道，要不问问他？”
    “等等，姐姐，我有个想法。”
    小青用了一个法术，变了个一样的瓶子，放在黑羊身下。白素贞再用了一个法术，把黑羊妖变回了游医的样子。黑羊妖一直在睡，没有醒。白素贞笑了笑，和小青一起离开了。
    回来后，白素贞把药瓶给许仙。她说：“我以前跟一位师父学过一些法术。刚刚想起来，那位师父以前也给过我一个这样的瓶子。我试过了，喝了里面的药水，病也能好。”
    许仙相信了，他倒了一些药水，看了一会儿后，高兴地说：“和游医的药水一样！”
fullText.traditional:
十三、遊醫的藥

    六月，西湖風景最美的時候，白素貞和許仙結婚了。他們一起住在了西湖邊。九月，許仙結束了他在藥店的工作。十月，他和白素貞在西湖邊開了一家藥店，白素貞賣藥，許仙給人看病。沒有病人的時候，他們就去山裡採藥，生活過得平靜而美好。小青和他們住在一起，看到他們過得幸福，她也很開心。
    很快，一年過去了。第二年春天，看病的人一下子多了起來，很多人都生病了。雖然他們看了醫生，也吃了藥，但病一直不能好。許仙這兒也來了不少病人，但他也看不出他們得的是什麼病。
    後來街上來了一個遊醫，他說他知道大家得的是什麼病。病人們都去找他，他只簡單地看了一下，就拿出一個瓶子，從瓶子裡倒出一杯水，說：“一百塊錢！喝了這個藥水，病就好了！”一百塊太貴了，很多人沒有錢，遊醫就把藥拿回去了，說：“有錢了再來！”有人想辦法到處借錢，終於借到了一百塊，買到了藥水。喝完藥水，病真的就好了。
    大家聽了，馬上都去借錢。很快，全城的人都在借錢，而遊醫也越來越有錢了。
    許仙想辦法拿到了一點兒遊醫的藥水，但他看了半天也不知道那是什麼藥水。白素貞看了一眼，心裡有些吃驚。她來到街上，遠遠地看到那個遊醫，然後她就明白了。
    晚上，白素貞和小青用了一個法術，來到了遊醫睡覺的房間。
    遊醫正在床上睡覺，白素貞再用了一個法術，遊醫變成了一隻黑羊。
    “姐姐，你說得沒錯，他真的是妖！還是隻黑羊妖！”小青說。
    白素貞在黑羊身下找到了那個藥瓶。
    “姐姐，這個瓶子真的是神仙的東西嗎？”
    “是的，這瓶子是南極仙翁的東西。裡面的水叫淨水，生病的人喝了馬上就能好。”
    “這麼好的東西，怎麼到了黑羊妖手裡？”
    “我不知道，要不問問他？”
    “等等，姐姐，我有個想法。”
    小青用了一個法術，變了個一樣的瓶子，放在黑羊身下。白素貞再用了一個法術，把黑羊妖變回了遊醫的樣子。黑羊妖一直在睡，沒有醒。白素貞笑了笑，和小青一起離開了。
    回來後，白素貞把藥瓶給許仙。她說：“我以前跟一位師父學過一些法術。剛剛想起來，那位師父以前也給過我一個這樣的瓶子。我試過了，喝了裡面的藥水，病也能好。”
    許仙相信了，他倒了一些藥水，看了一會兒後，高興地說：“和遊醫的藥水一樣！”

sentences.pinyin: hēi yáng yāo yì zhí zài shuì méi yǒu xǐng
sentences.english: The black sheep demon had been sleeping the whole time and hadn’t woken up.

sentences.simplified: 白素贞笑了笑，和小青一起离开了。
sentences.traditional: 白素貞笑了笑，和小青一起離開了。
sentences.pinyin: bái sù zhēn xiào le xiào hé xiǎo qīng yì qǐ lí kāi le
sentences.english: Bai Suzhen smiled, and left with Xiaoqing.

sentences.simplified: 回来后，白素贞把药瓶给许仙。
sentences.traditional: 回來後，白素貞把藥瓶給許仙。
sentences.pinyin: huí lái hòu bái sù zhēn bǎ yào píng gěi xǔ xiān
sentences.english: After returning, Bai Suzhen gave the medicine bottle to Xu Xian.

sentences.simplified: 她说：“我以前跟一位师父学过一些法术。
sentences.traditional: 她說：“我以前跟一位師父學過一些法術。
sentences.pinyin: tā shuō wǒ yǐ qián gēn yí wèi shī fu xué guò yì xiē fǎ shù
sentences.english: She said, “In the past I had learned some magic from a master.

sentences.simplified: 刚刚想起来，那位师父以前也给过我一个这样的瓶子。
sentences.traditional: 剛剛想起來，那位師父以前也給過我一個這樣的瓶子。
sentences.pinyin: gāng gang xiǎng qǐ lái nà wèi shī fu yǐ qián yě gěi guò wǒ yí ge zhè yàng de píng zi
sentences.english: I just remembered that the master once gave me a bottle like this before.

sentences.simplified: 我试过了，喝了里面的药水，病也能好。”
sentences.traditional: 我試過了，喝了裡面的藥水，病也能好。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ shì guò le hē le lǐ miàn de yào shuǐ bìng yě néng hǎo
sentences.english: I tried it, if you drink the medicine inside, the illness will also go away.”

sentences.simplified: 许仙相信了，
sentences.traditional: 許仙相信了，
sentences.pinyin: xǔ xiān xiāng xìn le
sentences.english: Xu Xian believed it.

sentences.simplified: 他倒了一些药水，看了一会儿后，高兴地说：“和游医的药水一样！”
sentences.traditional: 他倒了一些藥水，看了一會兒後，高興地說：“和遊醫的藥水一樣！”
sentences.pinyin: tā dào le yì xiē yào shuǐ kàn le yí huì'r hòu gāo xìng de shuō hé yóu yī de yào shuǐ yí yàng
sentences.english: He poured some medicine, looked at it for a while, and said happily, “It’s the same as the traveling doctor’s medicine!”

sentence_translations: 13. The Traveling Doctor’s Medicine
In June, when the scenery of the West Lake was at its most beautiful, Bai Suzhen and Xu Xian got married.
They lived together by the West Lake. In September, Xu Xian ended his job at the pharmacy.
In October, he and Bai Suzhen opened a pharmacy by the West Lake. Bai Suzhen sold medicine, and Xu Xian treated patients.
When there were no patients, they would go into the mountains to gather herbal medicine.
They lived a peaceful and happy life.
Xiaoqing lived with them, and seeing them happy made her happy too.
Soon, a year had passed. The next year in the spring, the number of patients suddenly increased. Many people were sick.
Although they saw a doctor and took medicine, the illness would not go away.
Xu Xian also had many patients, but he couldn’t tell what illness they had either.
Later, a traveling doctor came to town and said he knew what illness everyone had.
The patients all went to see him.
He just took a brief look, then took out a bottle, poured a glass of liquid from it, and said, ..
.. “One hundred yuan! Drink this medicine, and your illness will be cured! ”
One hundred yuan was too expensive.
Many people didn’t have the money, so the traveling doctor took back the medicine and said, “Come back when you have the money!”
Some people found ways to borrow money from anywhere possible, and finally managed to borrow one hundred yuan to buy the medicine.
After drinking the medicine, the illness really did go away.
Everyone heard about this, and immediately went to borrow money.
Soon, everyone in the city was borrowing money, and the traveling doctor was becoming more and more wealthy.
Xu Xian managed to obtain a bit of the traveling doctor’s medicine.
But after looking at it for a long time, he still couldn’t figure out what kind of medicine it was.
Bai Suzhen took a look and was a little surprised.
She went out onto the street, saw the traveling doctor from a distance, and then understood.
In the evening, Bai Suzhen and Xiaoqing cast a spell, and entered the room where the traveling doctor was sleeping.
The traveling doctor was sleeping on the bed.
Bai Suzhen cast another spell, and the traveling doctor turned into a black sheep.
“Older Sister, you’re right, he really is a demon! A black sheep demon, at that!” Xiaoqing said.
Bai Suzhen found the medicine bottle underneath the black sheep’s body.
“Older Sister, is this bottle really an object of the immortals?”
“Yes, this bottle belongs to the Old Immortal of the South Pole.
The liquid inside is called pure water. Sick people will recover immediately after drinking it.”
“How did such a good thing end up in the hands of the black sheep demon?”
“I don’t know, how about we ask him?”
“Wait, Older Sister, I have an idea.”
Xiaoqing cast a spell to create an identical bottle, and placed it under the black sheep’s body.
Bai Suzhen then cast another spell to turn the black sheep demon back into the form of the traveling doctor.
The black sheep demon had been sleeping the whole time and hadn’t woken up.
Bai Suzhen smiled, and left with Xiaoqing.
After returning, Bai Suzhen gave the medicine bottle to Xu Xian.
She said, “In the past I had learned some magic from a master.
I just remembered that the master once gave me a bottle like this before.
I tried it, if you drink the medicine inside, the illness will also go away.”
Xu Xian believed it.
He poured some medicine, looked at it for a while, and said happily, “It’s the same as the traveling doctor’s medicine!”
